NATIONAL TESTING AGENCY - EXAMINATION NOTICE
Ref: NTA/CUET-PG/2026/01
Date: 25 January 2026

Important Activity Schedule for CUET PG 2026:

1. Online Registration Commences: 01 February 2026

2. Normal Application Fee Payment Deadline: 10 March 2026 (11:50 PM)
3. Late Fee Window Submission Deadline: 20 March 2026 (11:50 PM)

4. Application Correction Window: 22 March to 25 March 2026

5. Final Cutoff Deadline for Form Submission: 10 March 2026

Eligibility: Bachelor's degree with 50% aggregate.
Registration Fee: Rs. 1200.
Portal: https://nta.ac.in/cuetpg2026
